translations.web: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
translations.bsb: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
translations.kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
translations.asv: Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.
